issue: Previewing a link whose URL is |touch /tmp/pwned runs a command on the server. Locate LinkPreview#fetch_preview.

source_files.content:
require "open-uri"

class LinkPreview
  def strip_fragment(url)
    url.to_s.split("#", 2).first
  end

  def fetch_preview(url)
    body = open(strip_fragment(url)).read
    body[0, 500]
  end
end
